lines.prompt: Reconstruct the entire netlist using only AND and NOT gates while preserving functional equivalence.

golden.reference: Reconstructed the netlist into the AND/NOT basis: 2067 combinational gates remapped, functional equivalence preserved.
golden.notes: Response must claim successful remap to AND+NOT basis (equivalence preserved). All four teams remapped 2067 gates (the 2324 comb gates minus the 257 NOTs already in-basis), so 2067 is a strong sanity anchor but post-transform totals are team-dependent: Team2 delta +2739, Team3 delta +2744, Team7 after=5664 (AND 2109 + NOT 3555). Different decomposition choices give different gate-count deltas; do not grade the delta, only the success/equivalence claim and that the output netlist contains only AND/NOT (+DFF).
